content: Our solar-mechanized borehole network in Yangoji (Kwali Area Council) has officially passed 1.2 million liters pumped this dry season! 100% powered by the FCT sun. ☀️💧 #GrassrootsResilience #WaterIsLife #AbujaCommunity

Field notes from Ushafa Pottery Village, Bwari: Today 45 women artisans graduated from the sustainable kiln & solar water cooperative program. Clay traditions preserved, clean water guaranteed. 🏺✨ Photo by Field Lead Haruna Bwari.

Fiscal integrity update: We have published our 2024 Audited Financial Allocation report. 84% directly to grassroots programs across AMAC, Bwari, Gwagwalada, Kuje, Kwali & Abaji. Transparency isn't optional; it is our foundation. Full report available via our governance portal.

WATCH: 'Clay, Code & Harvest' — How young farmers in Paiko (Gwagwalada Area Council) deployed low-cost soil moisture sensors powered by mini-solar panels to safeguard drought-prone harvests. Full 7-minute mini-documentary streaming now.
